properties.name: A revised affected list keeps the acceptances on the CHANGED edges it already drew
properties.rationale: Root cause walked as the skill (fact:revising-a-change-events-affected-list-resets-the-acceptances-already-on-its-changed-edges-2026-10-10, now closed and CAUSED by art:tools-temporal): the revise contract "a revise keeps what it was not passed" was held for node properties by upsert_node and never for an edge another tool decorates; CHANGED is the one such edge, so add_change_event was the only writer where the class bit. Reproduced on 0.82.0 with no gateway, which killed the hosted-path candidate. Anthony, 2026-10-11: "the /root-cause pass on the acceptance-reset finding". Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: add_change_event, on a revise, reads each CHANGED edge DrawnEdges::classify reports as already present and carries every stored property the call did not pass — the acceptance set_artifact_checksum put there (accepted_baseline, accepted_seq, checksum_after) survives — moving only `action`. Before, it re-created every edge with {action} alone and create_edge replaced the rest. Pinned by tests/a_revised_affected_list_keeps_the_acceptances_on_its_changed_edges.rs (2 of 3 failing on unchanged main); changelog fragment a-revised-affected-list-keeps-its-acceptances.md.
